explanation:
🔖Hints: ধরি, A, B, C এর বয়স A, B, C
তাহলে, B=2C ; A=B+2 = 2C+2
এখন, A+B+C =27
2C+2+2C+C=27
5C=25
C= 5
B=2C =2✘5 =10

explanation:

question: A person travels form P to Q at a speed of 40 kmph and returns by increasing his speed by 50%. What is the average speed for both the trips?
explanation:
🔖let, P to Q is x km. Thus he travels 2x km
1st Speed = 40kmph and 2nd speed will be = 40+40X50%=60kmph
Now, time to go P to Q = x/40 and time to come from Q to P is = x/60 and total time taken= x/40+x/60=5x/120=x/24
Thus, Average speed= 2x/(x/24)=(24X2x)/x=48kmph
Ans: Average Speed 48km/h

question: A train 360 m long is running at a speed of 45 km/hour. In what time will it pass a bridge 140 m long?

Time = 140 +360 /12.5 = 40seconds.

question: The speed of a boat in still water is 10 km/hr. If it can travel 26 km downstream and 14 km upstream in the same time, the speed of the stream is :
explanation:
🔖Hints: ধরি, stream এর speed x km/hr
এখন, উভয়ক্ষেত্রে একই সময় লাগে,
সময়= দূরুত্ব /বেগ
26 /(10+x) = 14/(10-x)
260 -26x =140+14x
40x=120
x = 3 km/hr

question: A sum of money amounts to Tk. 9800 after 5 years and Tk. 12005 after 8 years at the same rate of simple interest per annual is :
explanation:
🔖Hints: 8 বছর এবং 5 বছর এর মাঝের 3 বছরের interest = ( 12005 -9800) =2205
Simple interest 5 বছরের জন্য = ( 2205/3 × 5) = 3675
Principle =(9800-3675)=6125
Rate = {(100 × 3675)/(6125 × 5)}% = 12%

question: A certain amount is distributed among A, B and C. A gets \( \frac{3}{10} \) and B \( \frac{1}{4} \) of the whole amount . If C gets Tk. 81 then B gets:
explanation:
🔖Let a certain amount is x
A = 3x/10, B = x/4
ATQ,
(3x/10) + (x/4) = x - 81
11x = 20x - 1620
9x = 1620
x = 180
So B gets, 180/4 = 45 Tk (ans)

question: A, B and C can complete a piece of work in 24, 6 and 12 days respectively . Working together , They will complete the same work in:
explanation:
🔖1 day A does 1/24 part
1 day B does 1/6 part
1 day C does 1/12 part
They do together in 1 day ( 1/24+1/6+1/12) part
= 21/72 = 7/24
7/24 part do in 1 day
So 1 part do 24/7 day = 3 × 3/7 day (ans)

question: A pump can fill with water in 2 hours. Because of a leak, it took \( 2\frac{1}{3} \) hours to fill the bank . The leak can drain all water of the tank in:
explanation:
🔖Because of leak fill the tank in 7/3 h
In 1 hour fill the tank 3/7 part
Fill the tank in 2 hour
So in 1 hour fill the tank 1/2 part
ATQ,
1/2 - 3/7 = 1/14 part in 1 hour
So, 1 part fill the tank 14 hour
ans: 14 hrs
